post_title: What will Nvidia's (NVDA) closing share price be on Friday, November 27, 2026?

question.title: What will Nvidia's (NVDA) closing share price be on Friday, November 27, 2026?
question.description:
NVIDIA is the world's most valuable semiconductor company. On November 11, 2026, after the market close, The Wall Street Journal reported that Nvidia's board was preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang over alleged affairs; the shares fell roughly 8% in after-hours trading. On November 12, 2026, Nvidia's board announced that Huang had resigned as CEO effective immediately, that EVP and CFO Colette Kress had been appointed Interim CEO (she retains the CFO role until a permanent successor is named), that Harvey C. Jones had become the first-ever Chair of the Board, and that the board was working with an outside firm to identify CEO candidates (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition). Reported candidates include Arm CEO Rene Haas and Nvidia co-founder Chris Malachowsky. Huang has also reportedly agreed to appear before Congress.

The stock has been under heavy pressure. Daily closes per Nasdaq data: $178.67 (Nov 9), $168.89 (Nov 10), $173.73 (Nov 11, +2.87%), $166.19 (Nov 12, -4.34%, after touching an intraday 52-week low of $148.80), and about $159.2 on Nov 13, 2026 (-4.1%). The decline extends a stretch of six consecutive weekly losses, with roughly $1.6 trillion of market value erased and global AI-linked equities selling off alongside Nvidia. Baird cut its price target from $500 to $200 and downgraded the stock to neutral, citing uncertainty about the leadership transition. Analysts at Bloomberg Intelligence have argued that the pace of AI deals and China-related scrutiny are larger risks than the leadership vacuum itself.

Two scheduled events sit between now and resolution. First, Nvidia reports third-quarter fiscal 2027 results (quarter ended October 25, 2026) on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, with the conference call at 2 p.m. PT / 5 p.m. ET, after the market close (https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873); the prior quarter (Q2 FY2027) featured revenue of roughly $96 billion and diluted EPS of $2.46. Second, U.S. equity markets are closed on Thursday, November 26, 2026 for Thanksgiving and close early at 1:00 p.m. ET on Friday, November 27, 2026 (https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars), so the November 27 session is a thin, half-day, post-holiday session.

The relevant drivers for the November 27 close are therefore the market's reaction to the November 17 earnings report, any news about the permanent CEO search or Huang's congressional appearance, month-end flows, and broad AI-sector sentiment. The last close before the resolution date is expected to be that of Wednesday, November 25, 2026.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing price of NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) common stock in the regular trading session of Friday, November 27, 2026 (a scheduled shortened session that closes at 1:00 p.m. ET), as reported in the "Close" column of the historical prices table at https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/ for the row dated November 27, 2026, using the value as originally published for that date (not any later revision reflecting a subsequent stock split or corporate action). The answer is the price in US dollars per share as published by that source (e.g., a published close of 158.42 resolves as 158.42). If that page is unavailable or does not display a November 27, 2026 row, the "Close" value for that date at https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/history/ is used instead. If no regular trading session is held on November 27, 2026, the question is annulled.
